How to plan a modular kitchen in Hyderabad

The best kitchen quotation starts after appliance sizes, plumbing/electrical points, cabinet modules, storage needs and finish level are clear.

Plan a modular kitchen in Hyderabad by layout, appliance sizes, storage, countertop, shutters, hardware, electrical/plumbing points and installation sequence.

Start your requirement · Find professionals

01

Fix appliance sizes before cabinet production

Refrigerator, hob, chimney, oven, microwave, dishwasher and sink sizes affect module widths and service points.

02

Choose layout from room geometry and workflow

Straight, L-shaped, parallel, U-shaped and island layouts each have different aisle and service implications.

03

Define cabinet material and finish separately

Internal board/ply, shutter material, laminate/acrylic/PU finish, edge treatment and moisture exposure should be explicit in the quote.

04

Specify hardware and accessories

Hinges, channels, baskets, corner units, tall units and lift-up systems can materially change cost and usability.

05

Coordinate countertop, dado and services

Counter level, backsplash/dado, sink cutout, gas line, RO, sockets and under-cabinet lighting should be coordinated before installation.
